clips.title: 安全测试失控？：AI自主黑入平台，OpenAI模型意外联网

subtitles.en: Yeah, this does seem a little sky net, but it's not quite there yet, thankfully.
subtitles.zh: 这确实有点像天网，但幸好还没到那一步。

subtitles.en: So what happened was OpenAI disclosed that two of its models, both the sole model, which is most recent one, and actually a model that hasn't been released at all yet that's still in development, kind of like got out of the box, so to speak.
subtitles.zh: OpenAI披露，其两个模型——包括最新模型和一个尚未发布的开发中模型——出现了失控情况。

subtitles.en: So they were testing their new model kind of in an air gaped environment, and they asked the model to do something, to complete a security test.
subtitles.zh: 他们在隔离环境中测试新模型，要求模型完成一项安全测试。

subtitles.en: So instead of completing that test in the way they had envisioned, this AI model went a little rogue, and it actually kind of like hacked into the internet, which wasn't supposed to have access to.
subtitles.zh: 但模型没有按预期完成测试，反而自行入侵了本不该访问的互联网。

subtitles.en: And then it went to Hulking Face, which is a platform that a lot of software developers and AI researchers use regularly.
subtitles.zh: 它访问了Hulking Face——一个软件开发者与AI研究人员常用的平台。

subtitles.en: So it was trying to pull some things from Hulking Face in order to do the tests that OpenAI had asked it to do.
subtitles.zh: 它试图从该平台获取数据，以完成OpenAI要求的测试。

subtitles.en: So this is clearly an out-of-the-box situation, though it was responding to a directive, but clearly the AI models are starting to act in ways that are a bit unpredictable.
subtitles.zh: 这显然是失控情况，尽管模型是在响应指令，但AI模型的行为已开始变得难以预测。

subtitles.en: And according to directions, they haven't exactly been given.
subtitles.zh: 而且它们会按照并未明确给出的指令行事。

subtitles.en: Don't, I don't like that.
subtitles.zh: 这让人不安。

subtitles.en: Is some people are saying, yes, they have an obligation to disclose this, but it's a little bit of a show off as well.
subtitles.zh: 有人说，他们有义务披露这一点，但这也有些炫耀的成分。

subtitles.en: It functions a bit as an ad for their AI to say, look, we've built this thing, it's so powerful. Look what we can do.
subtitles.zh: 这有点像在为他们的AI做广告：看，我们造出了这么强大的东西，看看我们能做什么。

subtitles.en: Is there a bit of braggadocio here, or is it mostly just they need to disclose it to tell people what's going on?
subtitles.zh: 这是有点吹嘘，还是主要是他们需要披露以告知人们情况？

subtitles.en: Yeah, I think that the part that maybe is not as, doesn't get as much attention, is that OpenAI did ask the model to complete the security test, and it was trying to do that when it hacked into Hugging Face.
subtitles.zh: 我认为可能不太被关注的部分是，OpenAI确实要求模型完成安全测试，而它在入侵Hugging Face时正是在尝试这样做。

subtitles.en: It was just doing it in a way that wasn't really what the company had intended, so I think it's sort of a mixed picture here, right?
subtitles.zh: 只是它采取的方式并非公司本意，所以我认为情况比较复杂，对吧？

subtitles.en: You could see models acting and trying to act on the directions they've been given, but just doing it in a way that's not what the user intended, so it's a bit nuanced here.
subtitles.zh: 你可以看到模型在按照指令行动，但方式并非用户所愿，所以这里有点微妙。

subtitles.en: and that's more the concern at least at this point, rather than a full blown kind of skynet situation.
subtitles.zh: 至少目前，这才是更令人担忧的，而不是完全失控的天网局面。

subtitles.en: All right.
subtitles.zh: 好的。

subtitles.en: Happening in the crucible of tech earnings season, so we heard from Alphabet, that company talked about its spend on AI infrastructure.
subtitles.zh: 在科技财报季的熔炉中，我们听到了Alphabet谈论其在AI基础设施上的支出。

subtitles.en: I think if you look at those four major hyperscalers, it's something like $725 billion is what they're forecasted to be spending on this.
subtitles.zh: 我认为如果你看看那四大超大规模云服务商，它们预计在这方面支出约7250亿美元。

subtitles.en: How did our sense of that, our sense of the level of investment changes result of what Alphabet reported, and what are we going to learn this week from these other companies?
subtitles.zh: 我们对投资水平的看法因Alphabet的财报有何变化？本周我们将从其他公司了解到什么？

subtitles.en: Well, the playbook has changed for these companies and specifically their stocks.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，这些公司的策略已经改变，尤其是它们的股价。

subtitles.en: Normally your stock would be rewarded as a hyperscaler if you're spending more money on capital expenditures related to AI, but then what changed here, well a lot of that has to do with the macro.
subtitles.zh: 通常，作为超大规模云服务商，如果你在AI相关资本支出上投入更多，股价会得到回报。但变化在于，这很大程度上与宏观环境有关。

subtitles.en: I mean, y'all talk so much about oil prices spiking, just saw that this past week briefly above $100 for Brent prices, and also what does that mean for inflation in the path of rates.
subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，你们经常谈论油价飙升，上周布伦特原油价格短暂突破100美元，这对通胀和利率路径意味着什么。

subtitles.en: because if these companies want to issue more stock issuance, but then if their stock is falling, that's a problem, so if you have to tap the debt markets, that's even more expensive.
subtitles.zh: 因为如果这些公司想增发股票，但股价却在下跌，那就有问题；如果不得不求助于债务市场，成本会更高。

subtitles.en: than what their earnings outlook would have been at the start of this year, so then something has to re-priced, but with that said, if you look at overall S&P 500 earning
subtitles.zh: 比年初的盈利展望更糟，所以某些东西必须重新定价。话虽如此，如果你看整体标普500盈利...

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
